tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gyi mchog/zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /nyams len gsang ba'i nye lam bzhugs/ /
༄༅/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gyi mchog/zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /nyams len gsang ba'i nye lam bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gyi mchog /zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi// nyams len gsang ba'i nye lam bzhugs//

sde gzhung mchog sprul a 'jam zhabs kyi zhal rgyun man ngag mchan can/ ༄༅// rgyal ba sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang*// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam yas birwa pa// mtha' yas rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// shes bya kun gzigs rje btsun bsod nams rtse// bdag nyid chen po rje btsun rin po che// bstan pa'i sgron me sa skya paṇḍi ta// gsol ba 'debs so= /mkhas grub chen po tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal// dus gsum gzigs pa'i gnyen chen bsod nams brtan// rlung sems dbang 'byor chos rje brag phug pa// gsol ba= /thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal// snyan brgyud gdams pa'i bdag po dpal ldan pa// chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun bla ma gnyis// gsol ba= /rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po dang*// rgyal sras thu bo dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug la// gsol ba= /grub pa'i dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel// chos kyi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i zhabs// mkhas pa'i dbang phyug dkon mchog lhun grub la// gsol ba= /mkhas pa'i rigs 'khrungs nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*// mkhas pas rjes bzung bla ma dpal ldan pa// mkhas pa'i rgyud 'dzin shes rab 'byung gnas la// gsol ba= /sems dpa' chen po dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// skyabs kun gtso bo rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams thams cad la// gsol ba 'debs so= /mi bzod phung khrol bskyed pa'i rgyur gyur pa// bdag tu bzung ba'i yo byad ci mchis rnams// dpal ldan bla ma'i nyer mkhor 'bul lags kyi// 'dzin chags ser sna zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// 'jigs rung 'khor ba chags sdang 'phel ba'i rgyu// dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba ci mchis pa// rje btsun bla ma'i bran du 'bul lags kyi// chags sdang rang sar dag par byin gyis rlobs// nyes kun rtsa ba bdag 'dzin phung po 'di// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas// chos rje bla ma mnyes phyir 'bul lags kyi// bdag 'dzin rtsad nas thon par byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsum ngo bo nyid// gnas gsum yig 'bru'i tshogs las 'od 'phros pas// lus ngag yid la dbang bzhi bskur byas nas// lhan skyes ye shes skye bar byin gyis rlobs// cir snang thams cad rang gi sems su shes// sems kyang sgyu ma lta bur thag chod la// de yang spros kun bral bar rab rtogs nas// gnas lugs brjod bral bsgom par byin gyis rlobs//

zhes pa lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /na mo gu ru pā dā ya/ dben pa'i gnas su bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'dug la/ dal 'byor gyi rten la snying po len par 'dod pa'i 'dun pas lus ngag yid gsum 'jug pa rtse gcig tu bsgrims te/ bla ma la sangs rgyas su nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir du snying thag pa nas 'di ltar brjod cing bsam mo// bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' yi// mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus pa// dus 'di nas ni byang chub ma thob bar// phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rnams// gcig tu bsdus pa sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i gnas// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun gyi mnga' bdag che// dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi// spangs rtogs mthar phyin ston pa sangs rgyas la// sgo gsum gus pa= /lung rtogs bdag nyid bstan pa dam chos la// sgo gsum= /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// sgo gsum= / zhes lan mang du brjod/ bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rin po che// rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// khyed kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs// dam chos lam du longs par= /lam gyi 'khrul par zhi bar= /'khrul snang dbyings su 'char bar= /'di nas /chos min rnam rtog 'gag par= (/las ngan sdig sgrib 'dag par= /rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar=) /byams dang snying rje skye bar= /byang chub sems gnyis 'byong bar= /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs//

zhes lan gcig dang*/ (sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig ces pa lan gsum sogs gang thub brjod/ ) ma gyur 'gro rnams srid las bsgral ba'i phyir// bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya// de yi ched du sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod/ chos dbyings 'od gsal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// 'jigs med seṅges btegs pa'i rin chen khri// sna tshogs chu skyes nyin byed dkyil 'khor dbus// tshangs dbang khyab 'jug drag po brtsegs pa'i steng*// 'khor lo'i mgon po drin chen chos kyi rje// rtsa ba'i bla ma dges pa rdo rje'i sku// zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag can zhabs bzhi pa// bdag med yum dang rol pa'i gar gyis bzhugs// gang de'i dpral mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐// pad nyi'i gdan la 'od dang gzi brjid 'bar// gzugs phung rnam snang tshor phung rin chen 'byung*// 'du shes snang mtha' 'du byed don yod grub// rnam shes mi bskyod kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang*// sa khams spyan ma chu khams mā ma kī// me khams gos dkar rlung khams sgrol ma che// nam mkha' rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma// 'dren byed sa snying sgra 'dzin gsang ba'i bdag /dri 'dzin nam snying ro 'dzin spyan ras gzigs// sku lus sgrib sel yid dbang 'jam pa'i dbyangs// tshigs mtshams kun bzang rtsa rgyus byams pa mgon// phyag g.yas dus dgra g.yon pa gzhan mi thub// zhal sgo rta mgrin rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil// dpung g.yas mi g.yo g.yon pa 'dod pa'i rgyal// pus g.yas dbyug sngon can dang g.yon stobs chen// spyi gtsug 'khor sgyur zhabs mthil gnod mdzes rgyal// zag med yul rnams gzugs sgra dri ro dang*// reg dang chos khams rdo rje lha mo yi// ngo bor bzhugs pa rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog

/gzhan yang de mthar brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems// nyan thos rang rgyal chos skyong srung ma dang*// nor lha'i tshogs rnams dges bzhin bzhugs par gyur// de nas dad gus kyi shugs drag pos gang drin ma'am/ 'dren mchog bla ma kun gyi ngo bo nyid// ces sogs sam/ yang na/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// 'dren pa kun 'dus bla ma sogs dang*/ tshig rkang phyi ma gsum kun la 'gre ste/ === /yi dam kun 'dus= === /sangs rgyas kun 'dus= === /dam chos kun 'dus= === /dge 'dun kun 'dus= === /byang sems kun 'dus= === /nyan rang kun 'dus= === /chos skyong kun 'dus= === /nor lha kun 'dus= === /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid= === /ye shes lnga ldan= === /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin= === /don gnyis lhun grub= === /ma rig mun sel= === /thar pa'i lam ston= === /dgos 'dod kun 'byung= === /bsam 'phel nor bu= === /yid bzhin rin chen= === /dbang gi rgyal po= === /dran pas gdung sel= === /'gro ba'i 'dren pa= === /gcig chog rgyal po bla ma rin po che// drin can chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// zhes zhe thag pa nas gsol ba gdab bo// zhen pa spang ba ni/ gang la chags na nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// nyon mongs kyis bsags zas nor longs spyod kun// rje btsun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// rgyags dang ser sna zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// rang gi zhe sdang rang gzugs shar ba yi// gnod byed dgra 'drer snang ba ci mchis pa// rje btsun bla ma'i 'khor du dbul bar bgyi// zhe sdang dbyings su zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// ltar snang phan pas 'khor bar 'ching ba'i grogs// gnyen dang mdza' bshes 'khor g.yog la sogs pa// de kun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// 'dod chags rnam rtog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe rabs du mar grangs med mar byas kyang*// las nyon dbang gis gnyen ngo ma shes pa'i// bar ma'i 'gro rnams khyed la dbul bar bgyi// rmongs dang phrag dog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// rang lus phal par snang ba'i lag g.yas su// shes rab ral gri 'bar ba legs thogs te// tha mal lus su snang ba'i mgo bo yi// ya thod bcad nas mdun du bkan te bzhag

/gang de ches dkar yangs pa'i snod gyur par// rkang g.yon g.yas dang khog smad nang khrol dang*// khog stod lag g.yon mgo bo'i lhag ma dang*// lag pa ral gri bcas pa de nang bskyur// de la bsang sbyang byin rlabs rgyas par bya ba'am/ de tsam mi nus na/ oṃ las chos dbyings stong pa'i ngang nyid las// āḥlas ye shes thod pa cher yangs par// hūm̐ las sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga// hoḥlas dbyer med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// (oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum/ ) sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma rin po che// bdag gis mngon par bshams pa'i mchod pa 'di// bdag la brtse ba'i thugs kyis legs dgongs la// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes par mdzad du gsol// rang lus lha skur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas// yid 'phrog mchod pa'i lha mo mang spros pas// phyag gis thod pas bdud rtsi legs blangs nas// mchod yul rnams la phul te mchod par gyur// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhal du= /dges pa rdo rje'i= /brgyud pa'i bla ma'i= /yi dam lha tshogs= /sangs rgyas byang sems= (/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i=) /nyan thos rang rgyal= /chos srung nor lha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di// bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// mchod pa'i lha rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma yi// thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud zag med kyi// bde ba chen pos yongs su mnyes gyur te// mchog tu dges pa'i nyams dang ldan par gyur// bdud rtsi'i lhag ma rigs drug sems can rnams// lha ru gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// chags sdang rmongs gsum rnam rtog zhi ba dang*// byang chub sems 'byongs sangs rgyas thob gyur cig (/khyad par bdag la gnod byed gdon bgegs dang*// lan chags sha 'khon mgron rnams ma lus pa// tshim nas gdug pa'i bsam sbyor rab spang ste// sangs rgyas thob pa'i skal ba ldan gyur cig)

/rje btsun mchog gi mtha' skor bzhugs pa yi// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// nyan thos rang rgyal chos srung nor lha rnams// dbyings kyi rol pas bla ma'i thugs kar thim// dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po// oṃ gyi gzugs byung rang gi dpral bar thim// bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag /sku yis byin brlabs sprul sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po// āḥyi gzugs byung rang gi mgrin par thim// gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi dri ma dag /gsung gis byin brlabs longs sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po// hūm̐ gi gzugs byung rang gi snying gar thim// gsum pa'i dbang thob sems kyi dri ma dag /thugs kyis byin brlabs chos sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i yi ge gsum las 'od sna tshogs// 'bru gsum gzugs byung rang gi gnas gsum thim// bzhi pa'i dbang thob sgrib pa'i bag chags dag /kun gyis byin brlabs ngo bo nyid skur gyur/ (/bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa ni/ ) bla ma mchog dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i// gshis lugs brjod bral gsal snang ma 'gags pa// mos gus lam khyer phyag rgya chen po'i ngang*// bsgom bya sgom byed bral ba'i dbyings su bzhag / bla ma de rang sems dang dbyer med du gyur par bsams la/ lus bsam gtan gyi spyod lam bsgrim/ ngag rlung rang sor bzhag mig mdun gyi nam mkhar phyed btsum ran pas blta/ sems khong klod la dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul bcad de/ sems kyi gshis cir yang ma yin pa/ gdangs gang du'ang ma 'gag pa/ rtsal mos gus su dung nge ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i gsal le/ hrig ge ba/ stong sang nge ba'i ngang du ci nus shig bzhag la/

sangs rgyas kun 'dus phyi yi bla ma dang*// sems nyid 'od gsal nang gi bla ma dang*// rang bzhin spros bral don gyi bla ma gsum// dbyer med snying po'i bla ma rtogs par shog /dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams// dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma nyid// lhag pa'i lha ru shes pa'i mos gus kyis// dbang dang dngos grub rtag tu len par shog /lus ngag yid gsum longs spyod dang bcas pa'i// don yod rnam bzhis bla ma mnyes byas nas// ci mdzad rgyal ba'i mdzad pa legs rtogs te// rmad byung phrin las bsgrub la brtson par shog / ces brjod cing don yid la gtsogs par bya'o// de nas bla ma'i yon tan yid la dran pa dang*/ mdzad spyod kyi rjes su slob par 'dod pa dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba smon lam ci shes pa btab la/ chos dang mthun pa'i spyod lam gyis gnas par bya'o// 'di ni shin tu gsang ba'i 'os yin yang*// don gnyer slob mas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor// sbyar ba 'di la chos bdag mkha' 'gro yis// bzod pa mdzad de byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa nyams su blang bde ba'i phyir tshigs su bcad par byas pa zhig dgos so zhes rong po kun dga' bkra shis kyis nan chen pos bskul ba'i ngor/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po ratna wardhā yab sras kyi bka' 'bangs su btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis lcags glang zla ba gsum pa'i nyer brgyad kyi nyin e wam̐ chos ldan du sbyar ba'i dge bas sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig /shin tu gsang bar bya'o// //( ) rtags pa 'di rnams mchog sprul rin po che'i zhal rgyun ltar bcug pa yin no// des ni 'dren mchog dpal ldan bla ma la// ma dad ma gus log par sgrub pa'i las// ma lus sbyangs nas bka' bzhin lhur len pa'i// rgyal sras rtag tu ngu dang mtshungs par shog
/deng nas brtsams te srid pa thams cad du// bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs pad gus bsten cing*// rnam mang yon tan tshogs kyis mnyes byed pa'i// nor bzang gzhon nu ji bzhin bdag gyur cig /
tshar chen gyi gsung yin// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
